unitCases.name: host validation rejects invalid ports and excludes arbitrary SSH options
password stays out of disk and renderer without OS secure storage
encrypted credentials survive reload and never appear in public host objects
known host changed fingerprints are rejected; hashed OpenSSH host labels match
SSH sessions use independent PTYs and apply real window-change requests
SFTP lists real files, Unicode names, hidden files and symlinks without shell commands
separate connections to the same host cannot copy a directory into itself
text editor round trips Unicode and rejects stale saves and binary content
file creation, rename and deletion operate safely on SFTP including recursive folders
external opening streams a large SFTP binary into a private local snapshot without remote writes
local to SFTP and SFTP to local recursive transfers preserve content
transfer collision never silently overwrites; canceled queued transfers write nothing
SFTP to SFTP transfers stream between two independent hosts
authentication failure becomes a visible error without retaining a live connection
external-open classification preserves text and distinguishes binary from I/O failures
local program opening uses the existing local file and reports association failures
remote external opens isolate same-name snapshots and clean failed or canceled downloads
ssh2 write streams terminate when EOF arrives before their handle closes
a disconnected SFTP cleanup cannot keep a failed atomic write pending
Windows drive discovery tolerates unavailable volumes but preserves file operation errors
rejected or canceled writes do not open the source stream
native paths, Unicode files, optimistic edits, local transfers and permission preservation
directory aliases return canonical paths that still identify the requested Unicode file
script ANSI palette, truecolor, bold and underline survive; highlights respect explicit colors
highlight cell positions account for CJK, emoji and combining characters
CR and erase update one progress row; newline and alternate screen retain VT semantics
theme and highlighting settings persist and reject unknown presets
layout changes and cross-pane moves preserve exactly one owner for every session
reordering within a pane and removing an active tab select a valid neighbor
quick connection parser covers SSH, ports, IPv6 and rejects shell command strings

desktopCases.title: local file context menus target the clicked item, preserve multiple selection and paste into folders
SFTP context menus download, upload files/folders and transfer to the other pane
binary double-click opens independent local snapshots while text and read errors stay in the editor
same-name uploads require explicit overwrite and reset consent for every transfer
terminal sidebar right-click editing and six live themes work without reconnecting
automatic highlights preserve ANSI colors, progress redraw and alternate screens over SSH
native desktop SSH, SFTP, shortcuts, credentials isolation and window startup
